page_title: Glasp: PDF & Web Highlighter for Researchers & Learners

sources.entry: Glasp - Browser extension and web app that shows YouTube video transcripts with AI summaries and highlights web pages and PDFs. #freemium

summary.name: Glasp
summary.one_liner: Glasp is a free social web and PDF highlighter that saves highlights and notes from webpages, PDFs, YouTube and Kindle and turns them into a personal AI memory you can chat with.
use_cases: Highlighting and annotating articles and PDFs while reading
Summarizing YouTube videos with AI and timestamped highlights
Collecting research evidence across papers and web pages
Exporting highlights into Notion or Obsidian for writing
Studying lecture notes and PDFs from highlights
Asking an AI assistant questions grounded in saved highlights
summary.what_it_does: Glasp lets users select text on any webpage, PDF, YouTube video or Kindle book in Chrome, Safari or Edge, save it with an optional note, and organize it in one searchable library sorted by tag and author. It generates one-click AI summaries of articles, PDFs and YouTube videos, plus transcripts with timestamped highlights. Users can chat with their highlights and ask their memory to resurface ideas. Highlights can be imported from Kindle, Medium, Instapaper, Snipd and Hypothesis, and exported to Notion, Obsidian, Roam Research, or as Markdown, HTML, CSV or JSON. An MCP connector exposes highlights to Claude and other AI clients.
notable: Social highlighting: see and share others' highlights without a login
Built-in AI memory and chat grounded in the user's own highlights
MCP connector to use highlights inside Claude and other AI tools
Exports to Notion, Obsidian, Roam and Markdown/CSV/JSON
caveats: Glasp Pro raises AI usage limits for heavy AI users; base AI features are limited
Browser extension required for web and PDF highlighting; the page names Chrome, Safari and Edge
Page is largely marketing; no specific AI usage limits are stated
